meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会持续盯着指定的 PR：反复查看 CI 状态、评论和评审线程，把真实问题改掉、提交并推送，直到检查通过、没有待处理评论和未解决线程才停。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、监控或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、评审和 CI，直到所有可处理问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我盯着 #123 这个 PR，直到可以合并
say.note: 它会轮询状态并修复问题

say.text: 看看 #123 还有没有未解决的评审线程
say.note: 会列出未解决线程及所在文件行

say.text: CI 跑完把结果告诉我，有问题就直接改
say.note: 检查结束会汇报并推送修复

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude keeps watching a chosen PR: it repeatedly checks CI status, comments, and review threads, fixes real issues in focused commits, pushes, and only stops when checks pass and no actionable comments or unresolved threads remain.
howto.when_en: Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it's ready to merge
say_en.note: It polls status and fixes issues
Lists unresolved threads with file and line

say_en.text: Tell me when CI finishes, fix any failures
